title: DigitalOcean Review 2026: Droplet Prices, WordPress and AI Tools
excerpt: A DigitalOcean review from the provider's own pages: Droplet prices, backups, WordPress setup, the $5 credit and AI products.

meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: DigitalOcean review for 2026: Droplet prices from $4 a month, backup costs, WordPress on a Droplet, the $5 credit, GPU and AI products, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: DigitalOcean is a developer cloud with Droplets from $4 a month. You manage the server, and backups cost extra.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is DigitalOcean good for WordPress? | Only if you can run a server. DigitalOcean sells the server, and you manage updates, caching and security.
How much does DigitalOcean cost? | Basic Droplets start at $4 a month for 512 MiB RAM. A 2 GiB RAM Droplet is $12 a month.
Does DigitalOcean charge for backups? | Yes. It lists 20% of the Droplet price for weekly backups and 30% for daily.
Does DigitalOcean have AI products? | Yes. It lists Gradient AI Platform and GPU Droplets.
Is there a DigitalOcean free credit? | New accounts get a $5 credit for 90 days. No code is needed.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Droplets start at $4 a month.
Backups cost 20% or 30% extra.
New accounts get a $5 credit for 90 days.
You manage the server yourself.
